topic: Shallot and roasted garlic bread in a luxury kitchen
style: Photoreal food film in one elegant working kitchen. Brown butter, slow-softened shallots, roasted garlic, thyme and Gruyere make a balanced savory filling. Copper pans, brushed steel knife, dark walnut board, cream stone counter, warm under-cabinet light and window rim light. Realistic food, hands and tools; no floating objects or invented labels.
requestedEnding: The finished shallot and roasted garlic bread is torn open at the counter and served warm with a visible cheese stretch.

storyArc.visualBible: The same oblong crusty loaf, dark walnut board, cream stone counter, copper skillet, brushed steel knife, small brass butter bowl, and one pair of adult hands with natural nails recur. Camera stays close to real food actions. Golden brown crust, visible shallot flecks and thyme, soft roasted garlic, moderate melted Gruyere. No gloves, faces, text, packaging, logos, extra hands, dramatic smoke or impossible cheese stretch.

recipe.status: creative kitchen formulation; cook and taste before publishing as a tested recipe
method: Soften the shallots in gently browned butter with thyme; stir in squeezed roasted garlic.
Score the loaf without cutting through the base and spoon the aromatic butter into the cuts.
Add Gruyere, bake until the crust is crisp and cheese bubbles, then finish with flaky salt and serve warm.
